component.name: Saikou
component.summary: Native anime client with AniList tracking

description.p: A native Linux client for Saikou. Browse and watch anime from community sources, with playback handled by mpv and your library synced to AniList or MyAnimeList.
Saikou does not host or distribute any content. It reads publicly available websites, exactly as a browser would.
Phase 0: project scaffolding, core daemon, and RPC transport.
